3Q25 consolidated sales were THB 37,024 mn, declined by THB 1,510 mn or 
-3.9% YoY.
•PSC’s sales totaled  THB 5,654 mn, declined by THB 222mn or -3.8% YoY , mainly 
due to lower sales in the Glass segment.
•CSC’s sales were THB 5,552 mn, increased by THB 241mn or +4.5% YoY , robust 
growth in the Foods and Non -Foods segment, particularly snack and tissue 
paper.
•H&TSC ’s sales reached THB 2,037 mn, decrease d by THB 392mn or -16.1% YoY , 
driven by the divestment of TSS and a decrease of Healthcare supply chain 
sales.
•MSC ‘s sales totaled  THB 24,277 mn, declined by THB 1,111 mn or -4.4% YoY,  
driven by SSSG of -3.8% due to the Impact from the high sales base resulting 
from the government ’s THB 10,000 cash handout scheme launched in late Sep 
24, large -scale renovations, along with slower tourist arrivals. 
3Q25 consolidated adjusted net profit were 637mn, decreased by THB 
65mn or -9.2% YoY.
•PSC’s net profit  totaled THB 596mn, increased by THB 57mn or +10.5% YoY , 
driven by the Glass Packaging business due to lower input costs and improved 
operational efficiency.
•CSC’s net profit was THB 300mn, rising by THB 26mn or +9.4% YoY from an 
increase in high -margin products
•H&TSC’s net profit reached THB 245mn, surged by THB 36mn or +17.0% YoY , 
supported b y favorable product mix and the divestment of TSS.
•MSC’s net profit totaled THB 383mn, declined by THB 226mn or -37.2% YoY, 
driven by lower sales, lower other income and decreasing gross profit margin.38,534 37,024  (222) 241  (392)
